name: Lost in the World - 2D Platformmer
author: VasuLikesVases
description:
WASD/ Arrow keys for basic movement                                                      SpaceBar to Jump                                                                                                                      
Make sure to turn Volume on : )                                                                    
                                                                                                                     
Embark on an exhilarating journey through 'Lost in the World,' a captivating 2D platformer. Navigate vibrant, hand-drawn landscapes as you leap between platforms, encountering challenging puzzles and dynamic obstacles. The game's rhythmic gameplay is intricately woven into the pulsating beats of the music, creating a harmonious fusion of visual and auditory experiences. Immerse yourself in this lyrical adventure, where every jump, twist, and turn brings you closer to discovering the essence of being "Lost in the World.'"
